name: Folder
description: Interactive 3D-style folder that opens to reveal draggable document cards, in flap or book mode, with spring physics, optional WebGL glass, drag and drop and controlled open state.
contents: Folder body with back panel, tab with optional label and front cover that swings open
Up to 6 document cards from items, custom children, images or React nodes
Optional WebGL canvas that renders the frosted glass front
behavior: Front cover opens like a flap or a book cover with spring animation
Hover makes documents peek out of the folder
Opens on click or hover depending on openOn, closes on outside click or Escape
Documents can be dragged out and dropped back into the folder
Clicking a document zooms it to the front when zoomOnClick is true
Intro animation drops the documents in on first appearance
Reduced motion preference makes springs fully damped
Open layout of the documents is spread, row or stack

props.name: items
props.default: undefined (3 sample items: Brand guidelines, Launch plan, Moodboard)

editableByProps: Folder color, paper color, surface style, theme and size
Flap or book mode, tab position and label, open layout of documents
Document contents (text, images, custom nodes) up to 6
Open trigger, controlled or default open state, open callback
Drag, zoom, peek, intro toggles and motion feel (tilt, bounce, speed, frost)

needsCodeEdit.where: MAX_ITEMS constant (also FLAP_REST, SPREAD_TURN and SPREAD_DROP tables sized for 6)

needsCodeEdit.change: Change folder proportions or corner radius
Change glass lighting or refraction look
Change the look of the default blank document card

fixed: Requires a browser with canvas; the glass variant needs WebGL2 and falls back to CSS backdrop blur when unavailable
Client component only ('use client'), uses window, document and canvas
Adds document-level pointerdown and keydown listeners and window pointerup/pointercancel listeners while mounted
Uses an IntersectionObserver to start the intro when visible
Shows at most 6 documents, extras are ignored
Folder base size is fixed at 224x176 (flap) or 180x232 (book) pixels, scaled only by size, and the open layout extends beyond the folder bounds so it needs free space around it on small screens
Relies on Tailwind arbitrary value classes and CSS variables set internally
Document text on the glass canvas is rasterized from DOM, so only simple text and images render in the glass variant

options.look: Opaque gradient folder in the chosen color with a soft top highlight
options.useWhen: Default clean colored folder on any background

options.look: Frosted translucent front that refracts and blurs the documents behind it, rendered with WebGL
options.useWhen: Premium or glassmorphism interfaces over rich backgrounds

options.look: Flat single-tone folder with no gradient or highlight
